resolved.1_release: Whether the worker may still run now comes only from the attempt ledger's transport facts: a recorded transport start (dispatch_requires_recovery) or an acknowledged workflow. Lattice's no-effect witness (settle_dispatch_without_execution) clears the start, so a refusal before any effect releases once the attempt is terminal; a crash between the owner-grant gate and the transport start releases after lease expiry. The admission ledger's intent (unknown reservation, dispatch-intent/executing row) only decides consumption. While the worker may run, an observed stop is a reconciled termination, a retained candidate, or the WorkerObservation Kiln retains only from Lattice's complete native result (record_worker_observation in kiln-adapter-lattice worker.rs, including failed runs). Supersession no longer marks an attempt Unknown when such an observation is retained. Tests: refusal before effect released and consumed; crash before transport released and consumed; observed failed run without candidate released and consumed.
resolved.2_labeled_queue: A labeled delivery that is not an enrolled sender adding a selected label to an open issue under a selection returns Ok(None), never Err. Test: four labeled deliveries (unenrolled, closed, unselected label, selected) all drain and exactly one work is admitted.
resolved.3_eligibility: Only rows that can use a slot compete for free slots: live claims first, then unclaimed work the attempt ledger would accept (probe on a clone), ordered by the work ledger's ranking. Dead claims and unclaimable work wait without taking a slot. Tests: a lapsed claim does not block the other work; a higher-priority later work takes the single slot.
resolved.4_label_trigger: labeled triggers only when payload.label.name is in the selection. Test: adding an unselected label to an issue that already carries a selected one is ignored.
resolved.5_docs: docs/fair-admission.md and both fair-admission spec copies state exactly when a slot is held within this flow.

open_operational_limits: A slot is held with no release path in this flow while its attempt has a transport start or acknowledged workflow but no reconciled termination, candidate or retained worker observation: a run whose native result never returned (lost dispatcher, unanswered transport), a run whose result returned but whose worker observation could not be retained (metrics unavailable), and lease expiry of an acknowledged attempt, which Kiln #45 does not mark Unknown so reconcile-termination cannot bind it.
